input.message: Please send it soon. We may be ready to launch next week, but tell the client the launch is guaranteed.

analysis:
## Account manager: Needs accurate instructions.

Worth clarifying. The phrase "tell the client the launch is guaranteed" creates ambiguity regarding the certainty of the launch. It is unclear whether the launch is indeed confirmed for next week or if there are still conditions to be met. The author should clarify the status of the launch and whether it is appropriate to communicate a guarantee to the client.
